name: choro-mcp

tools.name: list_tabs
tools.description: List all open browser tabs with their ids, titles and URLs, which one is active, and which are used by this session or another agent session sharing the browser. With several browsers connected, each tab says which browser it is in.

tools.name: open_tab
tools.description: Open a new tab at the given URL and wait for it to load. The new tab becomes this session's default target.

url.description: URL to open; "localhost:3000" and "example.com" work too

active.description: Make it the visible tab (default true)

browser.description: Open it in this browser, when several are connected (default: the one this session last worked in). It becomes this session's browser.

tools.name: select_tab
tools.description: Make a tab this session's default target and the visible tab in its window (the window itself is not raised).

browser.description: The tab's browser, if the same tab id exists in several

tools.name: close_tab
tools.description: Close a tab (not one another agent session is using).

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a tab to a URL and wait for the page to load.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: go_back
tools.description: Go back in the tab's history and wait for the page to load.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: go_forward
tools.description: Go forward in the tab's history and wait for the page to load.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: reload
tools.description: Reload the tab and wait for the page to load.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Get a structured text outline of the page: headings, text, and every interactive element (links, buttons, inputs, selects, script-driven clickable elements...) tagged with a ref like [e12] that other tools accept. Includes the contents of iframes, cross-origin ones too (their refs look like f3:e12). Take a new snapshot after the page changes; refs from older snapshots may stop working.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: list_frames
tools.description: List every frame on the page (iframes, including hidden ones and ones inside shadow roots) with size, URL and whether Choro can see inside it (same-origin), not (cross-origin), or it belongs to another extension.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: get_text
tools.description: Get the visible text of the page or of one element.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

tools.name: get_html
tools.description: Get the live HTML of the page or of one element.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

tools.name: get_source
tools.description: Read source code: without url, the page's HTML as the server sent it (get_html shows the live, script-modified page instead); with url, a script, stylesheet or other text file (relative URLs resolve against the page).

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

url.description: A file to read instead of the page, e.g. a script URL from network_requests

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the tab: the visible area by default, the whole page, or one element. The tab becomes the visible one in its window; the window must not be minimized.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

fullPage.description: Capture the whole page (scrolls and stitches; very long pages are cut)

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click an element and report what it caused (navigation, new tabs, dialogs, network requests). Clicks a person couldn't make (disabled elements, elements behind a modal) are refused.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

offsetX.description: Click this many px from the element's left edge instead of its center (e.g. on a canvas)

offsetY.description: Click this many px from the element's top edge instead of its center

trusted.description: Send real (isTrusted) input through Chrome's debugger instead of simulated events, for sites that ignore simulated ones. Chrome shows a 'being debugged' bar meanwhile. Not available in Firefox.

dialog.description: How to answer alert/confirm/prompt dialogs this action opens. They are answered in the page and never shown; this works in every browser and on every page. Without it, a dialog blocks the page until handle_dialog.

promptText.description: Text to answer a prompt dialog with (with dialog: "accept")

tools.name: hover
tools.description: Move the mouse over an element (CSS :hover menus need trusted: true).

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

trusted.description: Send real (isTrusted) input through Chrome's debugger instead of simulated events, for sites that ignore simulated ones. Chrome shows a 'being debugged' bar meanwhile. Not available in Firefox.

tools.name: type
tools.description: Type text into an input, textarea or editor (contenteditable, rich text editors, an editor in an iframe). Date, time, color, range and number inputs are set to the whole value at once.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

text.description: Text to type, or for date/time/color/range/number inputs the value, e.g. 2026-10-07, 14:30, #ff0000, 70

submit.description: Press Enter after typing. In a textarea inside a form (e.g. Google's search box) this submits the form.

trusted.description: Send real (isTrusted) input through Chrome's debugger instead of simulated events, for sites that ignore simulated ones. Chrome shows a 'being debugged' bar meanwhile. Not available in Firefox.

tools.name: press_key
tools.description: Press a key, optionally with modifiers, on the focused element or a given one. Examples: "Enter", "Tab", "Escape", "ArrowDown", "a".

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

tools.name: fill_form
tools.description: Fill several fields at once. Each field is given by ref, selector or name; checkboxes, radios and switches take true/false, selects an option value or label. Fields that change again right after (e.g. a password manager refilling them) are reported.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: select_option
tools.description: Choose an option in a <select> element by value or visible label.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

value.description: Option value or label. For a multi-select, a list selects exactly those options; a single value adds one.

tools.name: set_checked
tools.description: Check or uncheck a checkbox, radio or switch.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Attach local files to a file input, as if chosen in the file dialog (which never opens). The target can be the <input type=file> (snapshot lists it as "file", even when hidden) or the button, label or area that stands for it; an area with no file input (a drag-and-drop zone) gets the files dropped onto it. At most 32 MB in all.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

paths.description: Absolute paths of the files, on the computer running the agent

tools.name: submit_form
tools.description: Submit the form containing the given element (or the form itself), reporting fields that fail validation.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

promptText.description: Text to answer a prompt dialog with (with dialog: "accept")

tools.name: drag
tools.description: Drag an element onto another: HTML5 drag and drop for draggable elements, otherwise a pointer drag (sortable lists, sliders). Both must be in the same frame.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: Element ref from the latest snapshot, e.g. "e12", or "f3:e12" inside a cross-origin frame. Preferred over selector.

selector.description: CSS selector, used when no ref is given. Also searches same-origin iframes and shadow roots.

name.description: Target the element by its visible text or label (e.g. "Send"), used when no ref or selector is given. Exact matches win; partial matches only count for buttons, links and fields. Useful for script-driven buttons.

to.description: The drop target, by ref, selector or name

trusted.description: Send real (isTrusted) input through Chrome's debugger instead of simulated events, for sites that ignore simulated ones. Chrome shows a 'being debugged' bar meanwhile. Not available in Firefox.

tools.name: scroll
tools.description: Scroll the page, scroll an element into view, or (element plus direction) scroll inside that element, e.g. a feed.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

ref.description: The element to scroll into view, or to scroll inside (with direction)

name.description: Like ref, by visible text or label

amount.description: Pixels to scroll (default: about one screen)

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until a CSS selector or a piece of text appears on the page (or disappears, with gone: true). Give one of the two.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss a JavaScript dialog (alert, confirm, prompt) that is blocking the page. Other tools report when one is, with its text. A dialog Choro couldn't take over can only be dismissed; in Firefox only the user can answer it (pass dialog to the action instead).

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

promptText.description: Text to enter in a prompt dialog before accepting

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Run a JavaScript expression in the page and return its (JSON-serializable) result. Promises are awaited.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

tools.name: network_requests
tools.description: List the network requests of a tab this session works in (page loads, fetch/XHR, scripts, images, WebSockets...), newest last, with status and timing. Filter to find e.g. the API call a click caused.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

method.description: Only this HTTP method, e.g. POST

status.description: Only these: "failed" (errors and 4xx/5xx), a class like "4xx", or a code like "404"

sinceLastAction.description: Only requests since the last click, typing, key press or navigation

limit.description: Show at most this many (the newest; default 50)

tools.name: network_request
tools.description: Details of one request from network_requests: request and response headers, request body, response body (text from fetch/XHR), timing, and messages for WebSockets. Cookies, tokens and password-like fields are hidden unless showSecrets is set.

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

showSecrets.description: Show cookies, tokens and password-like values

tools.name: wait_for_request
tools.description: Wait until a request matching the filters finishes after the last action (e.g. after clicking Save, wait for the POST to /api/save).

tabId.description: Target tab id (from list_tabs). Defaults to the tab this session last worked with, or the active tab. Tabs another agent session is using are off limits.

includeEarlier.description: Also accept a request that finished before the last action
